description: Adds a website to OhSnap so it is checked around the clock and the user is alerted when it goes down or comes back. Free accounts can monitor 5 sites every 5 minutes; Unlimited allows any number every 30 seconds. Pass alert_email if the account has no alert channel yet, otherwise the website will run silently. SMS, WhatsApp, Slack and Telegram alerts are configured in the OhSnap dashboard.

alert_email.description: Email address for down/up alerts. Used only if the account has no email alert channel yet.

check_frequency_seconds.description: Seconds between checks. Raised to the plan minimum (300 on Free, 30 on Unlimited). Defaults to 300.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the hostname.

url.description: Website URL or bare domain to monitor.

name: add_monitor
title: Start monitoring a website
